title.zh: Hyperliquid AQAv2储备机制完成首笔约1450万美元USDC收益分配用于回购HYPE
title.en: 【Hyperliquid 明日将收到首笔 AQAv2 储备收益分配，约 1450 万美元用于回购 HYPE】

current_state.zh: Hyperliquid 的 AQAv2 国库机制于 10 月 3 日完成首笔 1458 万美元 USDC 支付——资金用于援助基金回购 HYPE——按当前规模估算，这建立了一条年化约 1.93 亿美元的储备收益收入流。
current_state.en: Hyperliquid's AQAv2 treasury mechanism completed its first $14.58M USDC payment on Oct 3 — funds directed to the assistance fund for HYPE buybacks — establishing a reserve-yield revenue stream estimated at roughly $193M annualized at current scale.

updates.background_zh: Hyperliquid的AQAv2稳定币模型此前已获得26个验证者中19个的支持，相关机制预计自8月26日起正式产生收益。Circle已在Hyperliquid的HyperEVM网络上发行原生USDC，并首次投资HYPE代币。Hyperliquid将绝大部分永续合约和现货手续费收入输送至援助基金，用于买入HYPE。
updates.background_en: Hyperliquid's AQAv2 stablecoin model received support from 19 of 26 validators, and the mechanism was expected to begin accruing yields on Aug 26. Circle has issued native USDC on Hyperliquid's HyperEVM network and made its first investment in the HYPE token. Hyperliquid routes the bulk of its perpetual and spot fees to the Assistance Fund, which buys back HYPE.
updates.market_impact_zh: AQAv2付款将Hyperliquid上持有的USDC余额与协议收入相连接，而收入进入援助基金，因此跨链USDC供应量和保证金余额的增长会直接传导至HYPE的回购活动。由于Circle在HyperEVM上发行USDC，且Circle与Coinbase各质押50万枚HYPE并附带逾期罚没条款，相关发行方也对这一机制的运行承担敞口。
updates.market_impact_en: The AQAv2 payout ties USDC balances held on Hyperliquid to protocol revenue that flows into the Assistance Fund, so growth in bridged USDC supply and margin balances feeds directly into HYPE buyback activity. Because Circle issues the USDC on HyperEVM and Circle and Coinbase have each staked 500,000 HYPE with penalty provisions for late payment, those issuers also carry exposure to the mechanism's operation.
